title: Multidimensional efficiency and institutional scale heterogeneity in protected areas: Evidence from Italy
title_zh: 保护区多维效率与制度规模异质性：来自意大利的证据
title_primary: 保护区多维效率与制度规模异质性：来自意大利的证据
title_secondary: Multidimensional efficiency and institutional scale heterogeneity in protected areas: Evidence from Italy
authors: Giovanni Signorello, Marika Cerro, Laura Giuffrida, Maria De Salvo
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-21 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Protected areas play a central role in territorial governance and the provision of environmental public goods, yet their performance is typically evaluated through effectiveness-based frameworks rather than through efficiency analysis. This study provides a multidimensional assessment of 27 Italian National Parks, conceptualized as multi-mission public organizations operating within complex territorial and institutional contexts. Four mission-specific domains - ecological performance, tourism valorization, managerial administration, and governance capacity - are evaluated using Data Envelopment Analysis within a non-radial framework that captures asymmetric inefficiencies across functions. The analysis explicitly examines the role of institutional scale, distinguishing between pure technical inefficiency and structural scale effects. Results reveal differentiated performance regimes: ecological outcomes are largely anchored in territorial endowment, whereas tourism and managerial domains exhibit both slack-driven and scale-related inefficiencies. Governance performance appears strongly conditioned by the configuration of institutional scales. These findings highlight the importance of scale alignment and mission-specific benchmarking for improving the design and coordination of protected-area governance systems.
abstract_zh: 保护区在领土治理和环境公共产品供给中发挥着核心作用，然而其绩效通常通过基于有效性的框架而非效率分析来评估。本研究对27个意大利国家公园进行了多维度评估，将其概念化为在复杂领土和制度背景下运作的多使命公共组织。四个特定使命领域——生态绩效、旅游增值、管理行政和治理能力——采用数据包络分析在非径向框架内进行评估，该框架能够捕捉各功能间的非对称低效率。分析明确考察了制度规模的作用，区分了纯技术低效率与结构性规模效应。结果显示差异化的绩效模式：生态成果主要锚定于领土禀赋，而旅游和管理领域则表现出由松弛驱动和规模相关的双重低效率。治理绩效似乎受到制度规模配置的强烈制约。这些发现凸显了规模匹配和使命特定基准对于改善保护区治理体系设计与协调的重要性。

abstract: This paper reports key findings from the Sub-Saharan Africa Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC) and Digital Payments Survey, shedding light on the motivations, benefits, and challenges of CBDC adoption, as well as the developments of digital private money and crypto assets in sub-Saharan Africa. It emphasizes the pivotal role of collaboration and shared knowledge in navigating the intricate landscape of digital currencies and assets in sub-Saharan Africa. As this evolving digital frontier is explored, the experiences and aspirations of the region's central banks, as expressed in the survey, will help harness the potential for digital currencies, assets, and payments, and foster cooperation among countries in sub-Saharan Africa. A forthcoming IMF Departmental Paper will focus on key issues for countries in sub-Saharan Africa pertaining to CBDCs, private digital payments, and crypto assets. It will provide a deeper discussion of the benefits, costs, and risks of these digital payment systems and present policy options to enhance financial digital development and inclusion, while safeguarding macroeconomic and financial stability.

title: The Economics of Civil Service Protections
title_zh: 公务员保护的经济学分析
title_primary: 公务员保护的经济学分析
title_secondary: The Economics of Civil Service Protections
authors: Xu, Guo
official: 来源期次 Journal of Economic Literature · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: The study of bureaucracy as a key dimension of state capacity has gained increasing attention in economics. What organizational features create an effective bureaucracy, however, remains subject to debate. This paper focuses on the central role of civil service protections in delineating the boundary between politics and administration. I introduce a simple principal-agent framework to discuss the key theoretical channels through which political insulation can shape bureaucrat performance. Guided by the framework, I establish stylized facts and organize evidence from historical and contemporary civil service reforms. Overall, the micro-level evidence documents a positive effect of civil service protections on the quality of public service delivery. I conclude with open questions about the political economy of reform adoption.
abstract_zh: 官僚制作为国家能力的关键维度，其在经济学中的研究日益受到关注。然而，何种组织特征能够塑造有效的官僚体系，仍是争论焦点。本文聚焦于公务员保护在界定政治与行政边界中的核心作用。我引入一个简洁的委托-代理框架，探讨政治隔离影响官僚绩效的主要理论途径。在此框架指导下，我确立了若干典型事实，并系统整理了历史及当代公务员制度改革的相关证据。总体而言，微观层面的证据表明，公务员保护对公共服务供给质量具有积极影响。最后，我提出关于改革采纳的政治经济学未解问题。

title: The Unmeasured Cost of Fiscal Execution: Payment Timing and Public Service Delivery
title_zh: 财政执行中的隐性成本：支付时点与公共服务供给
title_primary: 财政执行中的隐性成本：支付时点与公共服务供给
title_secondary: The Unmeasured Cost of Fiscal Execution: Payment Timing and Public Service Delivery
authors: Zanoni, Wladimir, López, Rodrigo, Rangel, Marcos
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: When governments face fiscal stress, they frequently manage consolidation by delaying cash payments on legally incurred obligations rather than cutting explicit appropriations. This "execution wedge" reduces the real resources available for public production while leaving formal appropriations unchanged. We identify the causal effect of this adjustment margin using monthly administrative data from Ecuadors public health system, exploiting institutional features that make the cash execution pipeline observable and its frictions plausibly exogenous. A one-standard-deviation increase in the execution wedge reduces hospital discharges by 19.9 percent and increases the conditional inpatient mortality rate after 48 hours by 59 percent. Conversely, mortality within 48 hours an indicator of patient severity at arrival, is unaffected. These findings demonstrate that payment timing operates as an active fiscal policy variable with first-order welfare costs that are unmeasured in standard fiscal policy analysis.
abstract_zh: 当政府面临财政压力时，它们常常通过延迟支付合法产生的债务现金，而非削减明确的拨款，来实施财政整顿。这种“执行缺口”减少了可用于公共生产的实际资源，同时正式拨款保持不变。我们利用厄瓜多尔公共卫生系统的月度行政数据，识别了这一调整边际的因果效应，利用制度特征使现金执行流程可观察，且其摩擦具有合理的外生性。执行缺口每增加一个标准差，医院出院人数减少19.9%，48小时后的条件住院死亡率增加59%。相反，48小时内的死亡率——作为入院时患者严重程度的指标——则不受影响。这些发现表明，支付时点作为一种活跃的财政政策变量，其福利成本的一阶效应在标准财政政策分析中未被计量。

title_zh: 算法定价
title_primary: 算法定价
title_secondary: Pricing with Algorithms
authors: Lamba, Rohit, Zhuk, Sergey
official: 卷期日期 2026-09-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper studies Markov perfect equilibria in a repeated duopoly model where sellers choose algorithms. An algorithm is a mapping from the competitor’s price to own price. Once set, the algorithms respond quickly. Customers arrive randomly and sellers can periodically revise their algorithms. The main results are that (i) for the simple two-price model with standard profit functions, monopoly pricing is the unique equilibrium outcome, and (ii) for any general finite price grid, all equilibrium outcomes feature supra-competitive pricing. Sustenance of such collusion seems outside the scope of current antitrust laws for it does not involve any direct communication.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了一个重复双寡头模型中的马尔可夫完美均衡，其中卖方选择算法。算法是从竞争对手价格到自身价格的映射。一旦设定，算法会快速响应。顾客随机到达，卖方可以定期修改其算法。主要结论是：（i）对于具有标准利润函数的简单两价格模型，垄断定价是唯一的均衡结果；（ii）对于任何一般有限价格网格，所有均衡结果均呈现超竞争定价。这种合谋的维持似乎超出了现行反垄断法的适用范围，因为它不涉及任何直接沟通。

title: What Drives the Recent Surge in Inflation? The Historical Decomposition Roller Coaster
title_zh: 近期通胀飙升的驱动因素是什么？历史分解的过山车效应
title_primary: 近期通胀飙升的驱动因素是什么？历史分解的过山车效应
title_secondary: What Drives the Recent Surge in Inflation? The Historical Decomposition Roller Coaster
authors: Bergholt, Drago, Canova, Fabio, Furlanetto, Francesco, Maffei-Faccioli, Nicolò, Ulvedal, Pål
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: What drives the recent inflation surge? To answer this question, one must decompose inflation fluctuations into the contribution of structural shocks. We document how whimsical an historical shock decomposition can be in standard vector autoregressive (VAR) models. We show that the deterministic component of the VAR is imprecisely estimated, making the shock contributions poorly identified under general conditions. Our preferred approach to solve the problem—the single-unit-root prior—massively shrinks the uncertainty around the estimated deterministic component. Once this uncertainty is taken care of, demand shocks are the main drivers of the inflation surge in the United States, the euro area, and in four small open economies.
abstract_zh: 近期通胀飙升的驱动因素是什么？要回答这一问题，需将通胀波动分解为结构性冲击的贡献。我们揭示了标准向量自回归（VAR）模型中历史冲击分解可能存在的随意性。研究表明，VAR模型中的确定性成分估计精度不足，导致在一般条件下冲击贡献的识别效果较差。我们提出的解决方案——单单位根先验——大幅压缩了估计确定性成分的不确定性。在消除这一不确定性后，需求冲击成为美国、欧元区及四个小型开放经济体通胀飙升的主要驱动因素。

title: Political ecologies of urban encroachment: Power, governance, and land-use transitions in ecologically sensitive areas of Kumasi, Ghana
title_zh: 城市扩张的政治生态学：加纳库马西生态敏感区的权力、治理与土地利用转型
title_primary: 城市扩张的政治生态学：加纳库马西生态敏感区的权力、治理与土地利用转型
title_secondary: Political ecologies of urban encroachment: Power, governance, and land-use transitions in ecologically sensitive areas of Kumasi, Ghana
authors: Francis Okyere, Michael Osei Asibey, Emmanuel Amponsah
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-11 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Kumasi’s rapid urbanisation is exerting huge pressure on wetlands and urban green spaces. With increasing urbanisation, land-use changes are on the rise, which are detrimental not only to ecological systems but also to urban resilience. Using the political ecology approach, this paper demonstrates how power relations, governance arrangements, and actor interests interact to shape the dynamics and character of encroachment into ecologically sensitive urban green space. To be more specific, it (i) quantitatively assesses urban expansion-related land-cover change in Kumasi between 1994 and 2024, (ii) analyses the interests and narratives behind the involvement of actors in land use change processes, and (iii) examines how urban governance arrangements mediate these processes. The study employed both quantitative and qualitative methods. The analysis of satellite imagery was performed using Google Earth Pro and ArcMap. Fieldwork entailed a survey of households and officials of relevant institutions. Field verification was conducted using descriptive and regression analyses. The findings showed that the built-up areas have increased from 6.3 sq. km (55.5%) in 1994 to 8.0 sq. km (70.8%) in 2024. Whereas water bodies have declined from 3.7 sq. km (33.0%) in 1994 to 2.3 sq. km. This may still allow for some waterlogging during periods of heavy rainfall. However, the water bodies remain sufficiently large to serve as effective flood buffers. The critical insight is that encroachment is not something passively produced by demographic pressure. Rather, it is the product of governance gaps, uneven regulatory enforcement, and power negotiated among state actors, customary authorities, developers, and residents. The study reflects the reconfiguration of ecological spaces and the reiteration of socio-environmental vulnerability under the regime of governance-mediated urbanisation. The study proposes implementing interventions that integrate governance reform, community engagement, and ecological monitoring systems that combine remote sensing, municipal registries, and community reporting.
abstract_zh: 库马西的快速城市化正对湿地和城市绿地造成巨大压力。随着城市化进程的加快，土地利用变化日益增多，这不仅对生态系统有害，也削弱了城市的韧性。本文采用政治生态学方法，论证权力关系、治理安排和行为者利益如何相互作用，共同塑造生态敏感城市绿地被侵占的动态与特征。具体而言，本文：(i) 定量评估1994年至2024年间库马西与城市扩张相关的土地覆盖变化；(ii) 分析行为者参与土地利用变化过程背后的利益与叙事；(iii) 考察城市治理安排如何调节这些过程。研究采用定量与定性相结合的方法。卫星影像分析使用Google Earth Pro和ArcMap软件进行。实地调查包括对家庭和相关机构官员的问卷调查。实地验证采用描述性分析和回归分析。研究结果显示，建成区面积从1994年的6.3平方公里（55.5%）增加到2024年的8.0平方公里（70.8%），而水体面积则从1994年的3.7平方公里（33.0%）减少至2.3平方公里。这仍可能在强降雨期间导致一定程度的积水，但现有水体规模仍足以充当有效的洪水缓冲带。关键洞察在于，侵占并非由人口压力被动产生，而是治理缺口、监管执行不均以及国家行为者、传统权威、开发商和居民之间权力博弈的产物。本研究反映了在治理中介的城市化体制下，生态空间的重构以及社会-环境脆弱性的再现。研究建议实施整合治理改革、社区参与和生态监测系统的干预措施，该系统应结合遥感技术、市政登记和社区报告。

title: Blindly Discriminating: The GI Bill and Racial Inequality
title_zh: 盲目歧视：退伍军人权利法案与种族不平等
title_primary: 盲目歧视：退伍军人权利法案与种族不平等

authors: Lukas Althoff, Christiane Szerman
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The World War II GI Bill was the largest education subsidy in US history and a cornerstone of the postwar US transition to a knowledge economy. Although formally race-blind, the program's decentralized administration left implementation to local officials and segregated institutions, with sharply different consequences for Black and white veterans. This paper quantifies the GI Bill's impact on Black and white Americans' economic outcomes across two generations, using a regression discontinuity around WWII service eligibility cutoffs and a new data linkage from veterans in the 1940 and 1950 censuses to their sons' neighborhood outcomes between 1990 and 2025. The GI Bill widened racial inequality, doubling white veterans' college completion while steering Black veterans into often-fraudulent vocational programs with no earnings returns. The disparities persisted across generations, increasing the white-Black gap in sons' adult-neighborhood outcomes, including a 5-percentage-point (47 percent) widening of the racial college gap. Unequal returns to the same eligibility account for the intergenerational gap, with no contribution from prewar differences in socioeconomic status or geography. In sum, access to the GI Bill was not nearly the same economic opportunity for Black Americans as it was for white Americans, highlighting that race-blind policy does not guarantee racial equality.
abstract_zh: 二战《退伍军人权利法案》是美国历史上规模最大的教育补贴项目，也是战后美国向知识经济转型的基石。尽管该法案在形式上不区分种族，但其分散化的行政管理将实施权下放给地方官员和实行种族隔离的机构，对黑人与白人退伍军人产生了截然不同的影响。本文利用二战服役资格门槛附近的断点回归方法，结合1940年与1950年人口普查中退伍军人数据与其子代在1990年至2025年间居住社区结果的新数据关联，量化了《退伍军人权利法案》对两代美国黑人与白人经济成果的影响。该法案加剧了种族不平等：使白人退伍军人大学完成率翻倍，却引导黑人退伍军人进入常含欺诈性质的职业培训项目，且未带来任何收入回报。这种不平等持续至下一代，导致白人-黑人子代成年社区结果差距扩大，其中种族大学教育差距扩大5个百分点（增幅达47%）。代际差距完全源于相同资格获取权带来的不平等回报，战前社会经济地位或地理分布差异对此并无贡献。总之，《退伍军人权利法案》为美国黑人提供的经济机会远不及白人，这凸显了形式上的种族中立政策并不能保证种族平等。

title: The rise of Christianity, the demise of Greco-Roman religion, and economics
title_zh: 基督教兴起、希腊罗马宗教衰落与经济学
title_primary: 基督教兴起、希腊罗马宗教衰落与经济学
title_secondary: The rise of Christianity, the demise of Greco-Roman religion, and economics
authors: Mario Ferrero
official: 官方在线 2026-06-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper applies the economic approach to the history of Christianity in the religious environment of the Roman Empire, a ground already covered by Stark, Ekelund and Tollison. We show that Greco-Roman religion was not in decline and was not threatened by Christianity either in terms of numbers or influence, but it was a fragile system because it lacked a professional priestly class with an interest in its continuance; hence, when the emperors raised Christianity to state religion, it was doomed. Christianity rose slowly and inconspicuously, struggling to extricate itself from its Jewish apocalyptic beginnings; it was not a superior doctrine, and specifically not a superior afterlife promise, that drove its growth in its sectarian centuries. Rather, Christians were able to achieve a distinctive doctrinal identity and organizational unity only when Toleration offered them both opportunity and incentive to become a universal religion, and the emperors bet on that. On this reading, for all it was hell-bent on destroying paganism, Christianity emerged as its killer only by accident.
abstract_zh: 本文运用经济学方法，探讨了罗马帝国宗教环境中基督教的历史，这一领域已有Stark、Ekelund和Tollison的研究基础。我们指出，希腊罗马宗教并未衰退，也未在人数或影响力上受到基督教的威胁，但它是一个脆弱的体系，因为缺乏一个对其存续有利益关联的专业祭司阶层；因此，当皇帝将基督教提升为国教时，它便注定消亡。基督教缓慢而不显眼地兴起，艰难地摆脱其犹太末世论起源；并非其教义更为优越，特别是并非其来世承诺更为出色，推动了其在教派世纪的成长。相反，只有当宽容政策为基督徒提供了成为普世宗教的机会和激励时，他们才能实现独特的教义认同和组织统一，而皇帝们则押注于此。据此解读，尽管基督教一心要摧毁异教，但它成为异教的终结者纯属偶然。

title: Specialization or diversification? The role of financial statement comparability in shaping firm innovation strategy
title_zh: 专业化还是多元化？财务报表可比性在企业创新战略形成中的作用
title_primary: 专业化还是多元化？财务报表可比性在企业创新战略形成中的作用
title_secondary: Specialization or diversification? The role of financial statement comparability in shaping firm innovation strategy
authors: Junyi Tian, Zhuo Zhang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Understanding how financial reporting shapes firms’ innovation strategies is central to research at the intersection of accounting and strategic management. While prior studies examine the informational role of financial reporting, the impact of financial statement comparability (FSC) on innovation choices remains underexplored. Drawing on data from Chinese A-share listed firms, this study explores how FSC shapes firms’ choices between specialization-oriented and diversification-oriented innovation strategies. We find that higher FSC is significantly associated with greater related variety but has no significant effect on specialization or unrelated variety. Heterogeneity analyses show that the effect is stronger in high-tech industries and that FSC facilitates unrelated diversification among state-owned enterprises and firms in the decline stage of the firm life cycle. In the green innovation domain, FSC primarily promotes specialization rather than diversification. Additional tests reveal important boundary conditions: financing constraints weaken, whereas lower market competition strengthens, the positive association between FSC and related variety. Managerial and organizational factors also matter. CEO functional diversity reduces the marginal effect of FSC, whereas dynamic capabilities strengthen it up to a certain threshold. Our study provides new evidence on the role of financial disclosure in shaping firms’ innovation strategies and offers useful insights for practitioners.
abstract_zh: 理解财务报告如何塑造企业创新战略，是会计与战略管理交叉领域研究的核心。尽管已有研究探讨了财务报告的信息角色，但财务报表可比性（FSC）对创新选择的影响仍未得到充分探索。基于中国A股上市公司的数据，本研究探讨了FSC如何影响企业在专业化导向与多元化导向创新战略之间的选择。我们发现，较高的FSC与更大的相关多样性显著相关，但对专业化或非相关多样性无显著影响。异质性分析显示，这一效应在高科技行业中更为显著，且FSC促进了国有企业及处于企业生命周期衰退期企业的非相关多元化。在绿色创新领域，FSC主要促进专业化而非多元化。附加测试揭示了重要的边界条件：融资约束削弱了FSC与相关多样性之间的正相关关系，而较低的市场竞争则强化了这一关系。管理及组织因素同样重要。CEO职能多样性降低了FSC的边际效应，而动态能力在达到一定阈值前则增强该效应。本研究为财务披露在塑造企业创新战略中的作用提供了新证据，并为实践者提供了有益见解。

title: The Informational Role of Trading Volume in Thinly Traded Options Markets
title_zh: 交易量在交易清淡期权市场中的信息作用
title_primary: 交易量在交易清淡期权市场中的信息作用
title_secondary: The Informational Role of Trading Volume in Thinly Traded Options Markets
authors: Choe, Kyoungin, Goodwin, Barry K.
source: Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
official: 官方在线 2026-06-03 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Options on agricultural futures contracts are often thinly traded, with a significant percentage of contracts having zero trading volume across various strikes and maturities. When trading volume is zero, the Chicago Mercantile Exchange (CME) manually determines options prices. This study evaluates the accuracy and adequacy of these artificial prices. The results indicate that when trades occur after one or more days of zero volume, prices move significantly, suggesting that options settled with zero volume may not effectively reflect market expectations regarding future prices. Moreover, higher implied volatilities are often observed for options far into or out of the money, particularly for options with zero trading volume. Our findings provide insights into the crop insurance program, where implied volatilities derived from options serve as a key parameter in determining premiums.

title: Inherited inequality and the distribution of opportunities in the USA, China, India and South Africa
title_zh: 美国、中国、印度和南非的继承不平等与机会分布
title_primary: 美国、中国、印度和南非的继承不平等与机会分布
title_secondary: Inherited inequality and the distribution of opportunities in the USA, China, India and South Africa
authors: Paolo Brunori, Francisco H. G. Ferreira, Pedro Salas‐Rojo
official: 官方在线 2026-05-22 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Researchers have sought to quantify the extent of inequality that is inherited from previous generations or factors that are predetermined at birth in multiple ways, including a large body of work on intergenerational mobility and inequality of opportunity. Many of the most frequently used approaches to measuring mobility or inequality of opportunity fit within a general framework that involves, as a first step, an estimation of the extent to which inherited personal characteristics can predict current incomes. We suggest a new approach, within that broad framework, that is sensitive to differences across the entire conditional distributions of relevant population subgroups, rather than just in their means. Sensitivity to differences in higher moments of the conditional distributions allows for a comprehensive assessment of inherited inequality. We apply this approach to household income distributions in China, India, South Africa and the USA, to illustrate how the method performs in different settings. We find that inherited inequality accounts for large shares of total inequality, from 36% in the USA to 59% in China, 62% in India, and 81% in South Africa.
abstract_zh: 研究者们通过多种方式试图量化代际传承或出生前既定因素所导致的不平等程度，其中包括大量关于代际流动与机会不平等的研究。许多最常用的流动性与机会不平等测量方法均适用于一个通用框架：该框架的第一步是评估先天个人特征对当前收入的预测能力。我们在此框架内提出一种新方法，该方法关注相关人口子群体整个条件分布（而非仅均值）的差异。对条件分布高阶矩差异的敏感性，使我们能够全面评估继承性不平等。我们将该方法应用于中国、印度、南非和美国家庭收入分布数据，以展示该方法在不同情境下的表现。研究发现，继承性不平等占总不平等的比重从美国的36%到中国的59%、印度的62%以及南非的81%不等。

title: Basic income and employment
title_zh: 基本收入与就业
title_primary: 基本收入与就业
title_secondary: Basic income and employment
authors: Marta Aloi, Teresa Lloyd‐Braga
official: 官方在线 2026-05-14 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We analyse the general equilibrium implications of introducing a universal basic income (UBI) for employment and income in an economy characterized by involuntary unemployment. Our framework allows tax revenues and workers' reservation wages to adjust endogenously with employment to satisfy the government's budget constraint. We show that multiple equilibria may emerge and that a UBI can support higher employment when the initial equilibrium is characterized by high taxes. However, in this setting, replacing unemployment benefit schemes with UBI proves less effective at fostering employment, ultimately requiring higher taxes and yielding more limited welfare gains.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了在存在非自愿失业的经济体中引入全民基本收入（UBI）对就业和收入的一般均衡影响。我们的框架允许税收收入和工人的保留工资随就业内生调整，以满足政府预算约束。研究表明，可能出现多重均衡，且当初始均衡以高税收为特征时，UBI能够支持更高的就业水平。然而，在此设定下，用UBI替代失业救济计划在促进就业方面效果较弱，最终需要更高的税收，且带来的福利收益更为有限。

official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-09 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Direct public funding of R&D investment to stimulate technological innovation has a strong theoretical case and has gained renewed attention in recent times as a way to address the long-term challenges of modern society, such as economic growth, climate change, energy independence, and national security. We estimate the dynamic macroeconomic effects of government R&D investment and we find that it is very effective in fostering the national innovation effort by crowding in private R&D investment and raising aggregate output in the long run, but also that it stimulates a strong expansion from the outset, in particular through anticipation effects.
abstract_zh: 直接公共资助研发投资以刺激技术创新具有坚实的理论依据，近年来作为应对现代社会长期挑战（如经济增长、气候变化、能源独立和国家安全）的手段重新受到关注。我们估算了政府研发投资的动态宏观经济效应，发现其通过挤入私人研发投资并在长期内提高总产出，对促进国家创新努力非常有效，同时从初期就激发了强劲的经济扩张，尤其是通过预期效应发挥作用。

title: Trafficking as choice? Evidence from Nigeria
title_zh: 贩卖作为选择？来自尼日利亚的证据
title_primary: 贩卖作为选择？来自尼日利亚的证据
title_secondary: Trafficking as choice? Evidence from Nigeria
authors: Tamara Bogatzki, Daniel Meierrieks
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-05 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The discourse on human trafficking often depicts migrants as deceived victims, while alternative accounts view trafficking as a constrained migration strategy. We contribute to this debate using original survey data from two cross-sectional waves (2021 and 2023) covering more than 2700 respondents in Edo State, Nigeria. A substantial share of respondents reports a willingness to migrate via traffickers despite awareness of the risks of forced labor. A list experiment provides suggestive evidence of underreporting of trafficking approval, particularly among women, likely reflecting stigma surrounding sex work. We examine the determinants of trafficking approval through an aspirations–capabilities framework. Willingness to migrate via traffickers is highest among individuals with strong migration aspirations but limited capabilities. In contrast, exposure to anti-trafficking campaigns has little effect. Respondents are generally well-informed about the potential risks and returns associated with trafficking and do not exhibit cognitive biases such as motivated reasoning. Overall, our findings suggest that trafficking is not primarily driven by ignorance, but instead reflects a constrained choice shaped by limited legal migration options and structural barriers. • 1 in 4 would consider trafficking for migration despite forced labor risks in a representative survey in Edo State, Nigeria. • List experiment reveals gendered underreporting. • High aspirations and low capabilities predict trafficking approval. • Prospective migrants who would resort to trafficking hold reasonable risk and income expectations, with no evidence of motivated reasoning or selective recall. • Awareness campaigns show limited impact; structural reform is needed.
abstract_zh: 关于人口贩运的讨论常将移民描绘为受骗的受害者，而另一些观点则将贩运视为一种受限的迁移策略。我们利用2021年和2023年两轮横截面调查的原始数据，覆盖尼日利亚埃多州超过2700名受访者，为这一辩论提供实证依据。相当比例的受访者表示，尽管知晓强迫劳动的风险，仍愿意通过贩运者进行迁移。一项列表实验提供了暗示性证据，表明对贩运的认可存在低报现象，尤其在女性中更为显著，这可能反映了围绕性工作的污名化。我们通过愿望-能力框架考察贩运认可的决定因素。在具有强烈迁移愿望但能力有限的个体中，通过贩运者迁移的意愿最高。相比之下，反贩运宣传活动的接触影响甚微。受访者普遍对贩运相关的潜在风险和回报有充分了解，并未表现出动机性推理等认知偏差。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，贩运并非主要由无知驱动，而是反映了在有限合法迁移选择和结构性障碍下形成的受限选择。• 在尼日利亚埃多州的一项代表性调查中，尽管存在强迫劳动风险，仍有四分之一的人会考虑通过贩运进行迁移。• 列表实验揭示了性别差异性的低报现象。• 高愿望和低能力预测贩运认可。• 可能诉诸贩运的潜在移民对风险和收入持有合理预期，没有动机性推理或选择性记忆的证据。• 宣传活动影响有限；需要进行结构性改革。

title: Labor Markets, Financial Crises, and Inflation: Jobless and Wageless Recoveries
title_zh: 劳动力市场、金融危机与通货膨胀：无就业与无工资复苏
title_primary: 劳动力市场、金融危机与通货膨胀：无就业与无工资复苏
title_secondary: Labor Markets, Financial Crises, and Inflation: Jobless and Wageless Recoveries
authors: Guillermo Calvo, Emilio Colombi, Fabrizio Coricelli, Pablo Ottonello, Stefania Albanesi 等
official: 官方在线 2025-09-30 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We document the macroeconomic patterns that characterize labor market recovery from financial crises. Using a sample of postwar recession episodes from around the world, we show that financial crises are typically followed by jobless recoveries, with a sluggish recovery in employment relative to output. A departure from this empirical regularity occurs in emerging-market crises with high inflation, which feature strong employment recoveries but persistent declines in real wages and result in “wageless recoveries.” Our findings highlight the central role of financial components in labor input costs and nominal wage rigidities in shaping labor market dynamics following economic crises.
abstract_zh: 本文记录了金融危机后劳动力市场复苏的宏观经济特征。基于全球战后经济衰退案例样本，我们发现金融危机通常伴随无就业复苏，即就业相对于产出的恢复较为缓慢。这一经验规律在新兴市场高通胀危机中出现例外——此类危机呈现强劲的就业复苏，但实际工资持续下降，形成"无工资复苏"现象。研究结果凸显了劳动力投入成本中的金融成分与名义工资刚性在塑造经济危机后劳动力市场动态中的核心作用。

title: Bayesian evaluation of mutual fund performance with non-random missing data: Application to the Chinese market
title_zh: 非随机缺失数据下共同基金业绩的贝叶斯评估：中国市场应用
title_primary: 非随机缺失数据下共同基金业绩的贝叶斯评估：中国市场应用
title_secondary: Bayesian evaluation of mutual fund performance with non-random missing data: Application to the Chinese market
authors: Tianyi Liu, Qianchao Wang, Yanping Yi, Yonghui Zhang
official: 官方在线 2025-09-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper studies mutual fund performance evaluation, where non-random missing data is an important issue. Ignoring sample selection issues can lead to biased parameter estimates and invalid performance evaluation. Therefore, we propose a novel Beta selection model to characterize this non-random missingness mechanism. We can significantly reduce the bias in alpha estimates, by introducing our Beta selection mechanism into the Noise-Reduced Alpha (NRA) model of Harvey and Liu (2018). A computationally attractive Bayesian estimation procedure is also provided. Simulation results show that our proposed method achieves superior finite-sample performance compared to classical fund-by-fund ordinary least squares (OLS) and the baseline NRA model. Finally, we apply our method to Chinese mutual fund data, and find that: (i) our out-of-sample alpha forecasts exhibit greater predictive accuracy across all tested missingness rates; (ii) approximately 18% of funds exhibit statistically significant positive alphas, suggesting market-beating skill; and (iii) portfolios constructed using our method deliver significantly higher returns than those using alternative approaches.
abstract_zh: 本文研究共同基金业绩评估问题，其中非随机缺失数据是一个重要议题。忽视样本选择问题可能导致参数估计偏差及业绩评估失效。为此，我们提出一种新颖的Beta选择模型来刻画这一非随机缺失机制。通过将我们的Beta选择机制引入Harvey和Liu（2018）的噪声削减Alpha（NRA）模型，我们能够显著降低Alpha估计的偏差。同时，我们提供了一种计算上具有吸引力的贝叶斯估计方法。模拟结果表明，与传统的逐基金普通最小二乘法（OLS）及基线NRA模型相比，我们提出的方法在有限样本下表现出更优的性能。最后，我们将该方法应用于中国共同基金数据，发现：（i）在所有测试的缺失率下，我们的样本外Alpha预测具有更高的预测准确性；（ii）约18%的基金展现出统计上显著的正Alpha，表明存在超越市场的技能；（iii）使用我们方法构建的投资组合相比其他方法能获得显著更高的回报。

title: Smart city pilots and carbon emission reduction: impacts and transmission mechanisms—evidence from China
title_zh: 智慧城市试点与碳减排：影响与传导机制——来自中国的证据
title_primary: 智慧城市试点与碳减排：影响与传导机制——来自中国的证据
title_secondary: Smart city pilots and carbon emission reduction: impacts and transmission mechanisms—evidence from China
authors: Jing Zhang Kai Wan a Law School, Shanxi University of Finance and Economics, Taiyuan, Chinab School of Economics, Hangzhou Dianzi University, Hangzhou, China
official: 官方在线 2025-08-20 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Smart city construction is a new mode of urban development, which provides a new breakthrough for urban carbon emission reduction under the dual-carbon goal. Therefore, based on Chinese city-level panel data from 2000 to 2021 and using the smart city pilot policy as a quasi-natural experiment with a multi-period difference-in-differences (DID) approach, this paper explores the impact of smart city construction on carbon emissions and its transmission mechanism. The results show that smart city construction significantly reduces urban carbon emissions, and the conclusions remain robust after a series of robustness tests. The low-carbon effect of smart cities is more pronounced in resource-based cities and non-old industrial bases. Smart city construction mainly reduces carbon emissions by promoting green technology innovation and upgrading the industrial structure. However, unlike green technology innovation, smart city construction’s positive effect is limited to the scale of industrial structure upgrading. The findings of this paper provide empirical evidence for urban carbon emission reduction, and offers insights for the green development of smart cities.
abstract_zh: 智慧城市建设是城市发展的新模式，为双碳目标下的城市碳减排提供了新突破口。因此，本文基于2000—2021年中国城市层面面板数据，以智慧城市试点政策为准自然实验，采用多期双重差分法，探究智慧城市建设对碳排放的影响及其传导机制。结果表明：智慧城市建设显著降低了城市碳排放，经过一系列稳健性检验后结论依然成立。智慧城市的低碳效应在资源型城市和非老工业基地更为显著。智慧城市建设主要通过促进绿色技术创新和产业结构升级来降低碳排放。然而，与绿色技术创新不同，智慧城市建设的积极效应仅限于产业结构升级的规模层面。本文的研究为城市碳减排提供了经验证据，并为智慧城市的绿色发展提供了启示。

title: Firms’ dividend payments and financial insolvency: evidence from South Korea
title_zh: 企业股利支付与财务破产：来自韩国的证据
title_primary: 企业股利支付与财务破产：来自韩国的证据
title_secondary: Firms’ dividend payments and financial insolvency: evidence from South Korea
authors: Jaehyung Bark Pyung Kyung Kang Doseong Kim Jae Yoon Yoo a Department of Sports Convergence Welfare, Sehan University, Yeongam-gun, South Koreab Sogang Business School, Sogang University, Seoul, South Koreac ESG Strategy Team 等
official: 官方在线 2025-08-13 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study investigates the relationship between firms’ dividend payments and their designation as financially insolvent. We aim to identify a forward-looking indicator that can help predict potential insolvency. Using data from firms listed on the Korea Composite Stock Price Index (KOSPI) and the Korea Securities Dealers Automated Quotations (KOSDAQ) markets between 2005 and 2023, we find that dividend payments are negatively associated with financial insolvency designations. This suggests that firms at risk of insolvency tend to conserve liquidity by postponing or withholding dividend payments prior to being officially designated as insolvent. These findings offer practical insights for investors seeking to protect capital and enhance their understanding of financial sustainability. Moreover, this study underscores the potential of dividend policy as a proactive indicator of financial distress, providing valuable implications for market participants and regulators seeking to promote financial stability.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了企业股利支付与其被认定为财务破产之间的关系，旨在识别有助于预测潜在破产的前瞻性指标。基于2005年至2023年间韩国综合股价指数（KOSPI）和韩国证券交易商自动报价系统（KOSDAQ）市场上市公司的数据，我们发现股利支付与财务破产认定呈负相关。这表明，面临破产风险的企业倾向于在正式被认定为破产前，通过推迟或暂停股利支付来保留流动性。这些发现为寻求保护资本并增强对财务可持续性理解的投资者提供了实践启示。此外，本研究强调了股利政策作为财务困境前瞻性指标的潜力，为致力于促进金融稳定的市场参与者和监管机构提供了重要参考。
